scope: Read-only owner/job-scoped aggregate of existing local A2A child delegations, budget and reservations for the Zema parent progress view.
implemented: Derives parent state, approval/dispatch/run/reconciliation/result/failure/cancellation counts, and remaining shared budget from persisted child rows.
Rejects mismatched owner or parent-job records, duplicate child identities, and invalid budget conditions.
API list response exposes the snapshot and the Workbench displays progress and next safe user action.
Every paid child continues to require an explicit fresh approval; snapshot generation is read-only.
